// The parity gate's ratchet (crates/hale-codegen/tests/parity_gate.rs):
// the check/build divergences its generated programs reach today, one per
// line as `#<issue> | <reproducer> | <signature>`. Each reproducer is the
// minimized program beside this file, its files under `// == <path> ==`
// lines. A divergence whose signature is not here fails the gate; so does
// a listed reproducer that builds (or that the check refuses) again.
// Delete a line, and its reproducer, with the fix that closes it.
#1963 | capacity_slot_generic_arg.repro | hale can't compile this yet: no field `_` on locus self
#1963 | generic_unpinned_arg.repro | hale can't compile this yet: generic fn `_`: no argument of this call pins `_`
#1963 | unit_generic_arg.repro | hale can't compile this yet: call to `_`: no free fn / generic fn / fn-pointer binding with that name is in scope
#1963 | unit_method_generic_arg.repro | hale can't compile this yet: method `_` returns no value but is used in expression position
#1963 | unresolved_path_generic_arg.repro | hale can't compile this yet: path call `_` is unresolved
#1964 | imported_generic_call.repro | hale can't compile this yet: path call `_` in expression position
#1964 | imported_generic_call_stmt.repro | hale can't compile this yet: path call `_`
#1964 | imported_generic_literal.repro | hale can't compile this yet: stdlib path `_` (mangled `_`) not found in user_loci or user_types
#1964 | imported_type_generic_arg.repro | hale can't compile this yet: a named type as a generic argument (v# supports primitives and named types)
#1965 | template_literal_receiver.repro | hale can't compile this yet: expression form a record or locus literal
#1966 | or_generic_fallible.repro | hale can't compile this yet: `_` over call to unknown fn `_`
#1966 | or_on_field_read.repro | hale can't compile this yet: `_` requires a fallible call expression; got a field read
#1966 | or_substitute_type.repro | `_` substitute type mismatch: expected T, got T
